name: fetch
summary: Fetch a web page and return it as markdown (official MCP reference server, local stdio)

connect.identity: the public web, requested from this machine

notes: The server makes requests from YOUR machine to any URL it is given, so a prompt-injected page could steer it at internal addresses (SSRF). By default it refuses private, loopback, link-local and metadata addresses and checks every redirect, but the README says this does not stop DNS rebinding, and a host only a proxy can resolve is not checked.
Because of that risk the fetch tool asks first (consent) on every call.

Do NOT add the optional flags --allow-private-ips (removes the internal-address guard) or --ignore-robots-txt (stops obeying robots.txt for model-initiated requests) unless you understand the exposure. --user-agent and --proxy-url only change identity and routing.
No arguments or credentials are needed. No smoke test is configured because the only tool needs a URL.
Runs on your machine via uvx and needs uv. The version is pinned; update it deliberately.
